digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / lint and typecheck enforcement
propositions: Automated quality audit identified approved maintainability ratchets (C901 complexity, four Mypy settings, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, Ruff RUF hygiene) that cannot be enforced wholesale without first resolving existing pre-existing diagnostics.

Four child stories must execute in dependency order against a shared feature branch: d9f5 then 28cd then 125d; stories d9f5/28cd/125d that edit pyproject.toml have strict sequencing; 28cd creates the shared Ruff ratchet test and 125d extends it.

Every newly-enforced gate (C901 complexity wrapper, make lint, make typecheck, config-check) must exit 0 against the current origin/main tip before landing; pre-existing ratchet-family diagnostics on current origin/main (including drift since each story's baseline commit) must be resolved before the corresponding gate lands.

All four child stories must merge to main via a single no-ff merge-back change with Gerrit LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments; every child story similarly requires these labels and comment resolution.
After all children close, integration worktree must verify: make lint exits 0, make typecheck exits 0, config-check exits 0, pytest non-integration exits 0, and pytest integration tier exits 0.

C901 complexity story uses a shrink-only baseline at threshold 15; RUF diagnostics RUF001/002/003 are explicitly deferred; disallow_any_generics, disallow_untyped_defs, and Semgrep expansion are rejected from this epic.
